messages: zoe: Quick UX sync — SLO slider + capacity-locked pools. Ran a few tests and users are confused when they set strict latency but min==max. marco: Noted. The core problem is messaging: the slider implies the system will attempt to meet SLO, but if autoscaling is off the pool can't scale. Need clearer inline guardrail. rachel: Suggestion: when min==max and slider crosses the 'aggressive' threshold, show a compact warning pill: `May not meet SLO — pool locked`. Then provide two inline actions: `Enable autoscaling` and `Raise min`. jake: +1. UX question: should `Enable autoscaling` be a direct action or open a small config flyout? Product prefers minimal disruption, so inline confirm is preferred (small bar, Confirm/Cancel). priya: Engineering: we can surface `pool.lockedBy` (user|policy) and `pool.supportsBurst`. If supportsBurst=false, primary should be disabled with a tooltip: `Autoscaling unavailable for this pool`. Tooltip must be tabbable. zoe: Copy nit: prefer `Enable autoscaling` over `Allow autoscale`. Also make the warning tone mild — users shouldn't panic. Example pill copy: `Selected SLO may need autoscaling or a higher min.` marco: Accessibility: the warning pill should include an sr-only summary: `Warning: SLO may not be met; autoscaling is disabled for this pool.` Also when the inline confirm appears, it needs `role=dialog` and an aria-live announcement: `Inline confirmation: enabling autoscaling for pool X will allow size between A and B GPUs.` rachel: Add cost transparency: show `Est. +$0.10/hr` next to `Enable autoscaling` in muted text (if permitted by deployment). If private installs forbid estimates, hide that line. jake: Flow detail: user clicks `Enable autoscaling` -> inline confirm appears with details (min/current/max, est cost) -> Confirm applies change and shows a small ephemeral toast `Autoscaling enabled`. Keep everything keyboard-accessible and avoid full-page modals. priya: Implementation note: reuse InlineConfirm component; add an opt-in param `announceText` for aria-live. For disabled primary: use `aria-disabled="true" aria-describedby="autoscale-unavailable"`. Example: ``` Autoscaling is unavailable for this pool ``` zoe: small UI suggestion — show a faint lock icon on the capacity chip when locked, with tooltip `Locked by policy` or `Locked by user`. Helps users scan multiple pools. marco: agree. Also change SLO slider helper text to: `Sliders show estimated outcomes; enabling autoscaling may improve latency but could affect cost.` Link `Learn more` to docs. design-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.design/branch/slo-guardrail-locked-flow — includes dark mode and keyboard walkthrough. rachel: Action items: Zoe to update Figma strings (warning pill text, CTA verbs, lock tooltip), Priya to add supportsBurst + lockedBy to pool API, Jake to wire InlineConfirm with aria-live, Marco to draft acceptance criteria (contrast, sr text, tooltip focus, inline confirm trap). I'll tag for final signoff after copy updates. zoe: thanks team — I'll push the figma frame and add a small QA checklist for a11y tests.
